metadata.description: New architecture: LLM generates pure content, deterministic classifier selects palette+recipe based on content, post-processing applies them, HoloDeck enables instant client-side swapping. Zero token cost, no hallucination, instant selection, free swaps
metadata.context: Revised architecture for automatic style selection

metadata.description: Deterministic function that selects ideal palette and recipe based on variation content. Analyzes: tone (variation index), industry from hashtags, emotional temperature of headline. Returns paletteId, recipeId, reason. Zero cost, zero latency
metadata.context: Core function for automatic style selection

metadata.description: Selects palette based on content keywords: urgency (volcano-night), tech (cyber-lavender), health (cream-mint), sustainability (forest-bloom), luxury (mediterranean), beauty (blush-wine), creativity (golden-hour), gaming (moss-silver), lifestyle (pink-blush), fallback (tiffany-dark)

Selects recipe based on content structure: 3+ sections/lists (mosaic-collage), short headline ≤30 chars + short body ≤60 (brutal-split/glitch/editorial-poster), medium headline ≤50 (editorial-poster), long headline >50 (kinetic-type), emotional (glass-morphism)

New file server/ai/styleContentAdapter.ts. Uses Groq llama-scout (free, ~0.1s, ~200 tokens) to adapt content when user switches recipes requiring structural change. Function: adaptContentForRecipe(). Only called when necessary (lazy)
metadata.context: Module for adapting content to different recipe structures
